name: Archive & Repository Cleanup

tasks.content: Scan entire repository for files, assets, scripts, and directories no longer referenced in the active codebase.
Create /archive/YYYY-MM-DD/ folder at repo root using actual execution date and preserve original sub-paths inside archive.
Move all unused files into archive folder while maintaining original directory structure for traceability.
Run static analysis to confirm no code outside /archive/ imports or references anything inside /archive/.
Delete resulting empty directories to keep the active repository tree tidy.
Perform final verification that repository contains only actively used code and documentation.

research_topics: Static analysis tools for import detection
notes: This milestone implements the mandatory Repository Hygiene & Archiving Policy from development_plan.md Section 1.2
Failure to archive unused artifacts is considered a violation of the development plan
